name: Intrinsic Curiosity Module
principle: An inverse-dynamics-trained feature encoder discards observation changes not relevant to the agent's actions. A forward model predicts next-state features; its prediction error provides intrinsic curiosity reward.
learning_rule: phi=encoder(o); train inverse model g(phi_t,phi_{t+1}) to predict a_t and forward model f(phi_t,a_t) to predict phi_{t+1}; r_i=eta/2 * ||f(phi_t,a_t)-phi_{t+1}||^2. The paper combines inverse/forward losses with policy optimization.
backprop_notes: Paper describes jointly learned inverse/forward dynamics feature modules and an A3C policy trained from intrinsic reward, optionally combined with environment reward; this is gradient-based neural learning. Full-text section on method opened; exact implementation optimizer details not encoded here.

benchmarks.source: arXiv:1705.05363 full text, Table 1; ICM+A3C row (extrinsic reward setting, not a reward-free score)

limitations: Not a no-external-reward guarantee: paper also evaluates combined intrinsic and extrinsic reward.
No Crafter result verified in this paper.
notes: Paper also reports curiosity-only Mario/VizDoom exploration qualitatively; no table-backed Crafter result.
brain_relevance: Intrinsic novelty or prediction error could provide a local teaching/modulatory signal for a growing architecture, but this method itself uses a fixed conventional neural-network architecture and does not grow or prune structure.

name: Random Network Distillation

sources.title: explore, exploit, and learn: unsupervised exploration with deep reinforcement learning

principle: A predictor learns to match features from a fixed random target network. Prediction error is used as a novelty bonus, high for states not yet well represented by the predictor.
learning_rule: For observation o, fixed target f(o), train predictor g_theta(o) by minimizing ||g_theta(o)-f(o)||^2; use prediction error as intrinsic bonus. Crafter implementation's exact objective details were not specified in its paper text.
learning_signals: intrinsic: predictor error against fixed random features
optional extrinsic reward in original RND paper; absent in Crafter reward-free evaluation
backprop_notes: Predictor network is trained by gradient descent on feature-prediction error; target network is fixed/random. In Crafter's unsupervised evaluation environment reward is withheld, but the learning method still uses backprop.

benchmarks.source: arXiv:2109.06780v2 full text, Table 1 (RND, no provided reward; reported 2.0 ± 0.1 for RND and 2.1 ± 0.1 for Plan2Explore)

limitations: Curiosity can be dominated by unpredictable/noisy observations.
Crafter paper describes baseline at high level, not exact loss/optimizer details.
notes: Original RND abstract page reports no specific Crafter result; the 2.0% value comes from Crafter Table 1. Official standalone repository was not verified.

name: Planning to Explore via Self-Supervised World Models

sources.title: Planning to Explore via Self-Supervised World Models

principle: An ensemble of world-model predictors produces disagreement about future latent observations; the agent plans in imagined trajectories to maximize expected novelty, without task reward during exploration.
learning_rule: Train a world model from observations; compute intrinsic reward from ensemble variance of next-embedding predictions. Train actor-critic on imagined trajectories to maximize predicted disagreement. Full-text abstract/method opened; precise Crafter implementation gradient details not supplied by Crafter article.
learning_signals: downstream tasks may later use task reward
backprop_notes: Plan2Explore policy optimization propagates gradients through imagined rollout states and dynamics model according to opened full text. Exploration phase does not use task reward; subsequent adaptation can use rewards.

benchmarks.source: arXiv:2109.06780v2 full text, Table 1 (Plan2Explore, no provided reward; reported 2.0 ± 0.1 for RND and 2.1 ± 0.1 for Plan2Explore)

name: Never Give Up: Learning Directed Exploration Strategies

sources.title: Never Give Up: Learning Directed Exploration Strategies

principle: Combines episodic k-nearest-neighbor novelty in an inverse-dynamics embedding with optional lifelong RND novelty. A recurrent UVFA learns policies conditioned on intrinsic reward weight, including an exploitative beta=0 policy.
learning_rule: Augmented reward r_t=r_t^e+beta_i*r_t^i. Recurrent value learner uses transformed Retrace double Q-learning from replay; train inverse-dynamics embedding and optionally RND predictor. Episodic novelty arises from kNN distances in recent memory.
backprop_notes: Paper describes gradient-trained recurrent Q-network with transformed Retrace loss, inverse dynamics representation, and optional RND predictor. Not a reward-free agent as evaluated: uses augmented extrinsic plus intrinsic rewards.
limitations: Evaluated as reward-augmented Atari agent; no Crafter score verified.
Exact official implementation repository not identified from accessed paper text.
notes: Table 1 also reports other Atari scores; this record includes only one representative benchmark value.

name: Agent57
family: episodic and lifelong novelty / adaptive exploration

sources.title: Agent57: Outperforming the Atari Human Benchmark

principle: Extends NGU with episodic novelty multiplied by a lifelong RND signal, separately learned intrinsic/extrinsic value components, and an adaptive bandit selecting exploration-policy arms.
learning_rule: Intrinsic value and extrinsic value are learned separately with transformed Retrace losses; action selection combines Q=Q^e+beta_j Q^i. Per-actor bandit selects exploration arm using extrinsic episode return feedback.
learning_signals: intrinsic: episodic novelty scaled by lifelong RND novelty
extrinsic: Atari game return, also used by adaptive arm selector
backprop_notes: Uses gradient-trained value networks and RND predictor; paper explicitly reports recurrent backpropagation window details. Not reward-free in training/evaluation.

name: Episodic Curiosity through Reachability
principle: A reachability network estimates whether two observations are within a short action horizon. Episodic memory compares current state with remembered states; low estimated reachability produces a curiosity bonus.
learning_rule: Train R(o_i,o_j)=C(E(o_i),E(o_j)) as binary classifier for pairs within k steps versus beyond gamma*k. Bonus b=alpha*(beta-C(M,e)); combined RL reward r_hat=r+b.
learning_signals: extrinsic task reward, added to curiosity bonus
backprop_notes: The reachability comparator/embedding is trained with logistic classification; PPO trains policy/value networks on combined task plus bonus reward. Both use gradient-based optimization.
